acceptance_predicates.description: A declared clean source root is admitted and mounted read-only for the bound command.
Missing, symlinked, wrong-root, traversal, and unbound source roots are rejected fail-closed.
Single-root and existing product/state root-qualified envelopes retain their behavior.
Signed review, exact-head CI, merge, release, and post-merge verification pass without gate weakening.

definition_of_done: Source-root admission and sandbox mounting are implemented with focused positive and hostile tests.
Existing envelope and lifecycle tests pass.
The reviewed signed+DCO change is merged and released.

inputs.description: Clean external Coordinator checkout declared at invocation.

outputs.description: Identity-bound source-root selector and admission evidence.
Focused and full applicable nonformal test evidence.
Exact-head hosted review, merge, release, and reconciliation evidence.

gates.description: Root-qualified source, state, and product paths admit only their declared identities.
Focused and applicable full nonformal tests pass.
Exact signed/DCO head is reviewed, green, merged, and released.
